summary_snippets: Finding a good attorney who is not all about money is hard.

reviews.author: Lev Yakubov
reviews.text: Working with Akiva Shapiro was an outstanding experience from start to finish. He took the time to clearly explain every step of the process, making sure I fully understood my options and what to expect.

reviews.author: J. Phinnaeus Morgan
reviews.text: Akiva Shapiro was recommended by a very capable estate planning attorney, to say the least — he did not disappoint.

reviews.author: Estefany Canario
reviews.text: Finding a lawyer you can truly trust is rare — Akiva is one of them. Despite the reputation lawyers sometimes receive, Akiva proved to be the complete opposite. He represented me for several years with honesty and dedication.
